name: Can I install a garbage disposal with my new kitchen sink?

mainEntity.name: Can I install a garbage disposal with my new kitchen sink?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, a garbage disposal can typically be installed with most new kitchen sinks, provided there is adequate space under the sink and existing electrical wiring. The sink must have a standard drain opening, which nearly all modern sinks do. If you don't have an existing electrical outlet under the sink, a dedicated circuit and outlet may need to be installed by a qualified electrician, which would be an additional project step.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, a garbage disposal can usually be installed with a new kitchen sink, provided there's under-sink space and adequate electrical access.
